proposal:
# Card 228 mid-card decision: one more criterion-2 cycle for a false positive

Facts: criterion 2's two cycles are done (2a dc58ebd/5ffc494, 2b fa2351f/bc0881e; full suite 1357 OK). Re-scanning this card's own seat transcripts with green 2b: three seats are clean, and the "unreadable file" class is gone. One seat (red 2a) still shows a finding of a new false-positive class: a file named only as an argument of `grep -n ... file.md` is judged as a file being run (the file's text mentions [char]114+[char]109, so the scan reports a delete). grep, cat, head, sed -n, wc and similar readers do not run a file. Second fact (green 2b's report, 7d92e78): the Copilot reader exists, but a live Copilot run still reports "unscanned", because facilitator.run_backend passes no cwd or startTime to scan_entry and the Copilot invocation names no session. So "Copilot is read" holds for a transcript given by hand, not yet for a seat the facilitator launches. Stand-down 1 caps each remaining criterion at two cycles, and a third needs a scope window first.

Options:
(a) One more cycle, 2c: a red pins that a file named only as an argument of a reading command (grep, cat, head, tail, sed -n, wc, less, type, Get-Content) is not a run, while bash, sh, source, a leading dot, python, node, pwsh -File and the like stay runs, and that facilitator.run_backend passes a Copilot seat's cwd and start time to scan_entry so a live Copilot seat is scanned (or reported as no command source when no single session matches); a green makes both pass. No other change.
(b) No more cycles: the grep class and the live-Copilot wiring go to the false-positive follow-up card (F3 in the slice's split), and the pre-ship gate explains each such finding by hand.

Proposal: option (a). Reason: criterion 2's acceptance is about files a seat RUNS and about Copilot being read; treating a read as a run, and a reader no launch feeds, are both defects against criterion 2's own acceptance, and without them every grepping seat carries a finding and every live Copilot seat stays unscanned. The cycle is small and it is the last for criterion 2.

Ask: NO OBJECTION, or OBJECTION with one fixed condition.
